title: FoodLogAthl-218: Constructing a Real-World Food Image Dataset Using Dietary Management Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating within-class variability and between-class separability using feature dispersion metrics (Trace, Silhouette, Davies-Bouldin Index, Calinski-Harabasz Score) to demonstrate that the newly collected casual, unfiltered images overcome the lighting and styling biases of traditional web-sourced image datasets.

Measuring the model's tendency to default to common generic classes (e.g., predicting 'Rice' instead of specific variants) and evaluating how menu-aware, context-guided classification reduces this bias toward dominant labels.
